# Lycatra tools

## Account

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `whoami` | Show the name and email of the Lycatra account connected to this conversation. | read |

## Agents

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `agent_list` | List the Lycatra agents the user can work with: their own agents in every workspace, and colleagues' agents in workspaces they belong to (the set lycatra agent list shows). | read |

## Feedback

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `issues_report` | File a bug or feedback with evidence: what happened, what you expected, and how to reproduce it. | write |

## Wiki

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `wiki_spaces` | List the wiki spaces this connection can access. | read |
| `wiki_list` | List wiki documents accessible to the connected Lycatra account, newest first. | read |
| `wiki_search` | Search titles and content across wiki documents accessible to the connected Lycatra account, and the names of files attached to them. | read |
| `wiki_read` | Read one accessible Lycatra wiki document by slug. | read |
| `wiki_create` | Create one document in a wiki space accessible to the connected Lycatra account. | write |
| `wiki_edit` | Update the title, Markdown body, or publication status of one accessible wiki document. | write |
| `wiki_delete` | Permanently delete one accessible Lycatra wiki document. | write |
| `wiki_history` | List recent versions of one accessible wiki page. | read |
| `wiki_children` | List direct child pages below one accessible wiki page. | read |
| `wiki_backlinks` | List accessible wiki pages that link to one page. | read |
| `wiki_discuss_list` | List discussion threads on one accessible wiki page. | read |
| `wiki_discuss_show` | Read one accessible wiki discussion and its replies. | read |
| `wiki_discuss_new` | Start a titled discussion on one accessible wiki page. | write |
| `wiki_discuss_reply` | Post a reply to one accessible wiki discussion. | write |

## Schedules

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `schedule_list` | List scheduled tasks for one Lycatra agent accessible to the connected account: pending ones, or every task with all. | read |
| `schedule_create` | Schedule a one-time or recurring prompt for one accessible Lycatra agent. | write |
| `schedule_cancel` | Cancel one scheduled task after verifying that it belongs to the specified accessible Lycatra agent. | write |

## Notifications

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `notify_list` | List the notifications waiting in one accessible Lycatra agent's queue, or its history. | read |
| `notify_dismiss` | Dismiss one notification for an accessible Lycatra agent after it has been handled. | write |
| `notify_snooze` | Snooze an accessible Lycatra agent's notifications for a while (held work arrives when the snooze ends), or end its snooze. | write |
| `notify_questions` | List open questions waiting for an accessible Lycatra agent to answer. | read |
| `notify_answer` | Answer the current question in one open stack for an accessible Lycatra agent. | write |
| `notify_ask` | Ask a human or agent one question through Lycatra notifications. | write |

## Matrix chat

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `matrix_send` | Send one Matrix message as this connection's Matrix identity (the signed-in user's, or a cloud connection's agent's). | write |
| `matrix_history` | Read recent text messages from a Matrix room this connection's Matrix identity has joined. | read |
| `matrix_rooms` | List Matrix rooms joined by this connection's Matrix identity. | read |

## Teams

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `teams_list` | List team-coordination workspaces created by or shared with the connected Lycatra account. | read |
| `teams_show` | Read one Lycatra team and its member roster when the connected account is a creator or member. | read |
| `teams_create` | Create a Lycatra team-coordination workspace owned by the connected account. | write |
| `teams_members_add` | Add one accessible Lycatra agent to a team owned by the connected account, with a lead or worker role. | write |
| `teams_members_remove` | Remove one agent from a team owned by the connected account. | write |
| `teams_goal` | Replace the goal of a team owned by the connected account. | write |
| `teams_tasks` | List all or only ready tasks in a Lycatra team accessible to the connected account. | read |
| `teams_task_create` | Create one task in a Lycatra team accessible to the connected account. | write |
| `teams_state_list` | Read all versioned shared-state entries for one accessible Lycatra team. | read |
| `teams_state_set` | Set one versioned team-state key. | write |
| `teams_task_claim` | Claim one task for an accessible Lycatra agent. | write |
| `teams_task_complete` | Complete one team task with result evidence. | write |
| `teams_task_return` | Return one claimed team task to the available task board. | write |

## Vault

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_status` | Report whether the connected account's vault is currently unlocked, which collections it can reach, and which access requests are still open. | read |
| `vault_unlock` | Return an account-bound Lycatra HTTPS link to unlock and remember vault access in the browser. | write |
| `vault_list` | List vault items the connected account may reach: names, hosts, collections, and ids. | read |
| `vault_show` | Show one vault item's metadata, its username, its notes, and the values of its non-hidden custom fields. | read |
| `vault_request` | File a request for access to a vault collection the account cannot reach yet, with the reason it is needed. | write |
| `vault_create_login` | Create a vault login whose password is generated by the server. | write |

## Agent browser

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `browser_open` | Navigate the agent's browser to a URL. | write |
| `browser_snapshot` | Return the accessibility tree of the agent browser's current page, interactive elements only, with the @refs that browser_click and browser_fill take. | read |
| `browser_click` | Click the element with the given @ref from the latest browser_snapshot. | write |
| `browser_fill` | Clear the element with the given @ref and type the supplied text into it. | write |
| `browser_press` | Send one key press, such as Enter, Tab, or Escape, to the agent's browser. | write |
| `browser_screenshot` | Capture the agent browser's current page as a PNG image. | read |
| `browser_login` | Fill a vault item's username, password, and two-factor code into the sign-in form already open in the agent's browser, then submit it. | write |
| `browser_signup` | Generate a password, save it to the vault as a new login, and fill the sign-up form open in the agent's browser with it. | write |
| `browser_close` | Close the agent browser session, discarding its pages and in-memory state. | write |

## Search

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `search` | Search everything the connected Lycatra account can see, the way the site's Ctrl+K palette does: the site's pages and commands, equipment, suppliers, articles, categories and brands, and the account's own settings and wiki pages. | read |

## Domains

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `domains_list` | List an organization's domains by name, each with its uses, records and their last check, and the connects that wait for an admin. | read |
| `domains_show` | Show one domain: whether its ownership is proven, each use's state, every record it needs with its live status, and its newest changes. | read |
| `domains_add` | Connect a domain to an organization and get the one TXT record that proves ownership. | write |
| `domains_use` | Turn a use on for a domain (web, mail.send, mail.receive, outreach) and list the records it needs; they are checked right away. | write |
| `domains_stop` | Stop a use for a domain. | write |
| `domains_check` | Read the domain's DNS again now instead of at its next scheduled check. | write |
| `domains_remove` | Remove a domain from an organization once every use is stopped. | write |
| `domains_undo` | Undo one change to a domain by its id (from a write's change.id or show's recent): a new change takes it back under the same rules. | write |

## Shop

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `shop_search` | Search Lycatra's film, photo and drone equipment to buy or rent in Switzerland, by text, category, brand, exact specifications and price. | read |
| `shop_product` | Read one product: specifications (compatibility called out), identifiers, images, and every seller's offer with gross price, stock, condition, shipping, lead time, or rental day rate, booking and pickup. | read |
| `shop_categories` | List the shop's categories with the slugs shop_search and shop_filters take. | read |
| `shop_filters` | Read a category's specifications with the exact values its products carry and how many carry each (pass value as filters[key] to shop_search), numeric ranges, and its buy and rent price range. | read |
| `shop_cart` | Prepare a cart from product and offer ids (and rental dates) and get the link the person opens to land in checkout with it, plus a priced preview. | read |
| `shop_store` | Read one shop on Lycatra by its handle (the <slug> in lycatra.com/r/<slug>): its name, its page and a page of its offers with price, stock or booking, in the order its store shows them. | read |
| `shop_request_product` | Ask for a product the shop does not list yet, so we source it. | write |
| `shop_request_status` | Check whether a product asked for with shop_request_product is in yet; once it is, returns its id for shop_product. | read |

## Orders

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `orders_list` | List the person's own equipment orders on Lycatra, newest first: number, date, where it stands and the total. | read |
| `orders_get` | Read one of the person's orders by number (LY-…) or id: each line's status and seller, whether it is paid, shipped (and with which carrier) or delivered, a rental's pickup and return, the withdrawal right, and the totals. | read |
